question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"****linguistic."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use **"linguistic"** in the blank is to emphasize that Braille, signal flags, Morse code, and smoke signals are forms of non-verbal communication that, despite not relying on spoken words, still involve structured and symbolic systems.
 
• The term **"linguistic" **refers to the study or use of language, including both verbal and non-verbal forms of communication. (भाषा या भाषा विज्ञान से संबंधित; भाषावैज्ञानिक)
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: Other forms of non **linguistic**__ language can be found in Braille (a system of raised dots read with the fingertips), signal flags, Morse code, and smoke signals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Parodistic: **intentionally copying the style of someone famous or of a particular situation, making the features or qualities of the original more noticeable in a way that is humorous. (जानबूझकर किसी प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति या किसी विशेष स्थिति की शैली की नकल करना, मूल की विशेषताओं या गुणों को इस तरह से अधिक ध्यान देने योग्य बनाना जो हास्यप्रद हो)
 
• **Holistic: **considered as a whole thing rather than a collection of parts. (अखंड रूप में; समग्र रूप में)
 
• **Logistic: **the overall process of managing how resources are acquired, stored, and transported to their final destination. (संसाधनों को कैसे अर्जित किया जाता है, संग्रहीत किया जाता है और उनके अंतिम गंतव्य तक कैसे पहुंचाया जाता है, इसके प्रबंधन की समग्र प्रक्रिया)
